dataIdInfo.idAbs: The dataset was created by ITOS by converting the Morocco Admin Level 4 polygon layer to lines

Consts.useLimit: See the COD/FOD Registry Terms of Use. This does not replace any terms of use information provided with the dataset.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Administrative boundary lines for the Morocco admin level 0-4. Each line is attributed with the highest Admin level that it can represent. These lines can be helpful for cartographic purposes.

dataLineage.statement:
Administrative boundary lines for the Morocco admin level 0-4. The lines were created after all processing on the admin layer had been completed by ITOS.
An 'AdminLevel' field is used to attribute the lines. The values used for this field are: (0,1,2,3,4,5,87,88,99). 99 represents coastline. 0 is international border, 1 is Admin1 border, 2 is Admin2 border, etc. Each line is attributed with the highest admin level that it can participate in.
